limits.handling: Prior local PCR validation supports visible Metagonimoides cyst proxy; current survey does not genotype every larva. Do not extrapolate universal infection or parasite-driven flow selection.

One stream, three rain-free days. Empty riffles discarded before comparison. Nine shared riffles included in both species groups. Ten photographed rocks are substrate subsamples, not larvae. Encounter means are not tolerances or experimental preferences.
Source states mean ± one standard error. Do not reinterpret as SD or physiological range; retain units and group sizes.
Source pairs larval caddisflies with Ephemeroptera, an inconsistent taxonomic label. Do not silently certify either identification. Sampled potential prey/Jaccard 0.76 are not measured diet.
Seven folkertsi females attending upstream nests are observed. Amphileucus high-flow nest selection is proposed, without observed nest counts or experimentally tracked choice.

Larval periods 2 versus 3–4 years are cited background. Drift, drought advantage and competitive mechanisms untested here. Captive aggression/cannibalism cited from earlier work not current field observation. Nonsignificant shared counts do not prove equal competition.
Single-stream pattern not certified throughout sympatric range; no complete range, seasonal absence or current conservation assessment established.
